summary: SPECIAL EDITED VERSION 『ONE PIECE』魚人島編 (One Piece Log: Fish-Man Island Saga, Fuji TV Sun 09:30, 2024-11-03 → 2025-03-30, 21 eps) is a re-cut of the parent anime's Return to Sabaody + Fish-Man Island arcs — 57 parent episodes (517-541, 543-573) condensed into 21, with new video/audio and new next-episode previews but NO new story material. Its coverage in One Piece's own chapter space is a single unbroken run: ch 598 → ch 653, i.e. the Fish-Man Island Saga end to end. Every one of the 21 rows is canon and every one takes an anchor: ep 1 STARTs at ch 598 p.1 (「Two Years Later」, the timeskip return) and the TERMINAL is ep 21 — END ch 653 「The Hero Hat」 (pp. 4, 6-19), the last chapter of the Fish-Man Island Arc and of the Fish-Man Island Saga, vol 66. Two independent wikis agree page-for-page: onepiece.fandom's Log episode table (Log ep → parent eps → manga chapters) and opwiki.org's per-Log-episode 'Umgesetzte Kapitel' field, which prints the exact page ranges. The Log deliberately DROPS the two parent episodes that are not straight Fish-Man Island manga: parent 542 (the anime-original Toriko crossover special, our stored filler row) and parent 574 (新世界へ！, ch 654 pp.2-19 + 655 p.2) — onepiece.fandom's Episode 574 page states outright that it 'is the only episode of the saga not to be reworked into Special Edited Version'. So the honest terminal is 653, NOT 655: ch 654-655 are never in this entry, and the post-series continue is ch 654 (C5 = 653 + 1). G37: MU's former pin 'As of EP 1168' was the PARENT franchise's frontier (One Piece the ongoing TV series, Elbaf era) and has nothing to do with this entry — refused/deleted §12.94, and correctly so; this entry's coverage ceiling is 653 and 653 alone. IDENTITY: rows 7-21 do not exist yet (flag #166); the row → title → JP air date table for all 21 is in structure.notes from three agreeing sources (ja-WP, onepiece.fandom, opwiki.org). Rows 2-6 carry the CRUNCHYROLL (US) date, one day early — five air_date repairs; note 2025-03-09 was a broadcast skip week (ep 19 aired 2025-03-16).

THE TERMINAL (G56). A4/A10: condenses parent 569-573 and runs to the last page of ch 653 「The Hero Hat」 — onepiece.fandom's Chapter 653 page states it is 'the last chapter of the Fish-Man Island Arc and the Fish-Man Island Saga'. Content check on pages: the Shyarly/Camie farewell (653), the three-needle New World Log Pose (653), the pinky promise with Shirahoshi (653), the straw-hat-for-the-hero-kid beat (653), Big Mom's candy call and Luffy's declaration of war (651), the Tamatebako bomb (652) and the Smoker/Tashigi G-5 scene (652) — every character in the fandom episode page's appearance list falls inside 649-653. The episode does NOT reach ch 654: parent ep 574 (ch 654 pp.2-19 + 655 p.2) is the ONE saga episode not reworked into the Log. Row does not exist yet (A42).

No further One Piece Log entry exists (no Punk Hazard Special Edited Version has been announced as of 2026-09), so the reader continues either at manga ch 654 or, in the anime, in the PARENT One Piece series at episode 574 「新世界へ！最強の海をめざして」 (ch 654 pp.2-19 + ch 655 p.2), then 575-578 (the anime-original Z's Ambition arc, filler) and 579+ for Punk Hazard.

annotations.note: The whole entry is a condensation: 57 parent TV episodes re-cut into 21, with scenes trimmed and a handful of manga pages dropped inside otherwise complete chapters (e.g. 604 p.14, 630 p.9, 642 pp.2-5, 648 pp.9-10). Chapter COVERAGE is nevertheless continuous 598 → 653 with no gap. New music, new SFX, Dolby Atmos re-dub and new next-episode previews are presentation, not story — T28: no new anime-original segment exists in any of the 21 episodes, so no row is mixed or filler.

WHAT THE LOG DROPS. Two parent episodes of the 517-574 span are NOT reworked: (a) parent 542 「チーム結成！チョッパーを救え」, the anime-original Toriko × One Piece crossover special — our catalog already types parent 542 filler, and the Log's chapter run is unbroken across it; (b) parent 574 「新世界へ！最強の海をめざして」 (ch 654 pp.2-19 + ch 655 p.2) — onepiece.fandom's Episode 574 page states 'It is the only episode of the saga not to be reworked into Special Edited Version'. That is exactly why the terminal is 653 and not 655: the Log's own last title 「さらば魚人島！最強の海〝新世界〟へ」 fuses the titles of parent 573 AND 574, but the CONTENT is parent 569-573 only. The title is a merge, not a coverage claim (the 'title ≠ content' trap).

CHAPTER SPACE. One Piece's own serialized chapter numbering (the space our parent one-piece anchors and the volume boundary table use). v61 = 595-603, v62 = 604-614, v63 = 615-626, v64 = 627-636, v65 = 637-646, v66 = 647-656; the entry's coverage 598-653 sits inside v61-v66. No conversion is needed and none was applied. Three anchors span a volume boundary (ep 9: 614/615; ep 14: 626/627; ep 20: 646/647) — the `volume` field carries the END chapter's volume in each case.

G37 — THE MU PIN. MangaUpdates' former coverage pin on this entry, 'As of EP 1168', is the PARENT franchise's frontier: One Piece the ongoing TV series was at episode 1168 in its own count, an episode of the Elbaf era roughly 500 chapters past anything this entry contains. It is not a chapter number at all and it is not this entry's coverage; the refusal/deletion in §12.94 (G32 single foreign segment) was correct. This entry's honest ceiling is chapter 653 — the pin is not 'redundant', it was simply about a different work.

TYPES. All 21 rows are canon. The Log adds no story: onepiece.fandom's per-episode 'Edit Notes' record only CUTS (ep 1: the Chocolat/Nami exchange removed; ep 15: a compression around Robin's clone), never additions, and the new element of the re-edit is presentation — remastered line work and shading, remade cuts, new music and SFX, a Dolby Atmos re-dub, and newly produced next-episode previews. Under T28 new framing/preview material is not a standing change, so no row is mixed and none is filler. The one anime-original episode inside the parent span (542) was excluded from the Log outright.

Chapter completeness: opwiki gives page ranges but not each chapter's total page count, so 'the episode finished chapter N' is inferred from the next episode starting at N+1 for every row except 10, 11 and 17 (where the overlap proves the mid-chapter stop directly). If a chapter's last pages were dropped somewhere in 1-9, 12-16 or 18-21, the END number is still correct — only the C1 judgement would change.
